canonical_project: New Alamein City COC Data Centre (Giza Systems)
owner: New Alamein City Authority; Giza Systems (EPC)
notes: Giza Systems awarded the Command Operations Control (COC) Data Centre project by the New Alamein City Authority, located at the Authority's premises; project part of Egypt Vision 2030 smart-city buildout, reported completion within a year of the November 2024 award.
